{{Quote|High Command believes the Fatality's cargo is so important, they won't even tell me what it is. I'm just supposed to find it.|Avrun|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Avrun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], fighting broke out in the area designated [[Section X]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]''&mdash;a stolen Imperial warship carrying advanced [[HK-51 series assassin droid]]s&mdash;was discovered. Avrun was dispatched by [[Imperial High Command (Sith Empire)|Imperial High Command]] to investigate, though he was not told the cargo. He sent several squads into the vessel, but they were wiped out by the [[Dread Host]] that had taken the ship for themselves.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Avrun was added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 1.5, where he is part of the HK-51 mission series for the Imperial faction. In an earlier version of the HK-51 missions, Avrun and the ''Fatality'' were located on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the [[Glacial Fissure]], and were involved in the mission "Precious Cargo".<ref name="TOR" />
